primitives.name: Fixture Slate Exclusion Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # DAL@GB - FIXTURE NOT CONFIRMED (card REFUSED) **This matchup is not a game on the real 6 slate.** The engine does not emit an analyst card for a fixture it cannot confirm.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{S}': 'set of confirmed fixtures in period 6', '\\mathcal{C}': 'set of analyst cards emitted by engine', '\\mathcal{F}': 'set of all possible fixtures'}
primitives.assumptions: The engine operates under a deterministic exclusion principle: \( \forall f \in \mathcal{F}, \text{if } f \notin \mathcal{S}, \text{ then } \mathcal{C}(f) = \emptyset \)
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \mathcal{F} \cap \mathcal{S} = \emptyset \), the system enters a refusal regime.

layer2.mapping: The exclusion operator mirrors a set inclusion test in Bayesian belief updating: \( P(\text{card} | f \in \mathcal{S}) = 1 \) vs \( P(\text{card} | f \notin \mathcal{S}) = 0 \)
layer2.telemetry: Card emission status (valid/invalid) as function of fixture membership in \( \mathcal{S} \)

primitives.name: Fictional Card Rejection Principle
primitives.verbatim_quote: A card here would be fiction that reads as analysis.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{F}_{\\text{fiction}}': 'set of fictional game configurations', '\\mathcal{A}': 'set of analyst-generated content'}
primitives.assumptions: Any \( a \in \mathcal{A} \) must be grounded in \( \mathcal{F}_{\text{real}} \subseteq \mathcal{F} \), else \( a \in \mathcal{F}_{\text{fiction}} \Rightarrow \neg \mathcal{A} \)

layer2.mapping: Rejection kernel \( R(f) = \mathbb{I}_{f \notin \mathcal{F}_{\text{real}}} \cdot \mathcal{A}(f) \) filters out non-real configurations.
layer2.telemetry: Card validity score based on configuration realism check

primitives.name: Reparameterization Hint Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## What to do instead - Re-run against the actual game (the real opponents are named above).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{H}': 'hint space of valid reparameterizations', '\\mathcal{W}': 'set of weeks/periods'}
primitives.assumptions: Valid reparameterizations exist such that \( \exists w \in \mathcal{W}, \text{s.t. } f(w) \in \mathcal{S} \)
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \mathcal{F} \cap \mathcal{S} = \emptyset \), hint operator \( \mathcal{H}(f) \) provides \( w^* \in \mathcal{W} \) to resolve.

layer2.telemetry: Week ID suggestion for valid fixture resolution
